paraphrase: Kōfukuji asks the court to stop Hōnen's exclusive nenbutsu for nine errors: establishing a new school without imperial sanction; making a new image (the maṇḍala of the embracing light that shows only nenbutsu people embraced); slighting Śākyamuni; hindering the myriad good practices; turning against the kami; being ignorant of the Pure Land (the grades of birth include other practices); misunderstanding the nenbutsu (reducing it to oral calling); harming the Buddhist order (despising precepts); and disturbing the nation.
speaker: Jōkei (for Kōfukuji)
notes: Not in local corpus; recalled, no original quoted.
